stories.title: Lifestyle-associated microbiome axes separate health and disease signatures
stories.takeaway: In 6,803 Japanese adults, investigators found opposing microbial mediation patterns linking lifestyle factors to health and chronic disease.
stories.what_happened: Shotgun metagenomics and mediation analysis connected diet and activity with a health-associated metabolic axis versus an oral-pathobiont-enriched disease axis.
stories.why_it_matters: Adds population-level evidence for testing microbiome-mediated lifestyle hypotheses without assuming causation.
stories.caveat: Observational mediation is sensitive to residual confounding; findings need replication across populations.

stories.title: Spatial multi-omics maps glioblastoma cell-state transitions
stories.takeaway: An atlas of 12 human glioblastomas suggests that regional cellular environments track developmental-like to injury-response and hypoxic cancer states.
stories.what_happened: Researchers combined single-cell transcriptomic, epigenomic and genomic profiling across spatially sampled tumor regions.
stories.why_it_matters: Demonstrates how tissue geography and multi-omics can refine disease-model interpretation.
stories.caveat: Observational human tumor atlas; trajectories are inferred and do not by themselves establish lineage causality.

stories.title: Nectin-4 identified as a major rubella virus entry factor
stories.takeaway: Proximity proteomics and genetic perturbation identified nectin-4 as a functional receptor supporting rubella entry.
stories.what_happened: CRISPR loss-of-function and ectopic expression experiments linked nectin-4 to viral attachment and endocytosis in relevant cell systems.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates the value of receptor discovery and human-cell validation for infectious-disease modeling.
stories.caveat: Cellular entry mechanism does not alone establish clinical efficacy of receptor-targeted interventions.

stories.title: Direct RNA sequencing reveals layers of aging-associated transcript regulation
stories.takeaway: Long-read direct RNA sequencing highlights transcript features that conventional short-read expression summaries can miss in aging studies.
stories.what_happened: The study profiles aging-associated transcriptome regulation using direct RNA sequencing.
stories.why_it_matters: Points to improved RNA characterization strategies for tissue engineering and disease models.
stories.caveat: The reported associations require functional validation; platform and sample context limit generalization.

stories.title: Endothelial IDH2 lactylation investigated in diabetic atherosclerosis
stories.takeaway: Experimental work links IDH2 K272 lactylation and alpha-ketoglutarate metabolism with endothelial function in diabetic atherosclerosis.
stories.what_happened: The study investigates a specific post-translational modification and metabolic pathway in vascular disease models.
stories.why_it_matters: Broadens interest in metabolism–barrier interactions and mechanistic vascular tissue readouts.
stories.caveat: Disease-model findings should not be interpreted as a validated human treatment.
